name: benchmark-vidore-v3-physics
description: A multimodal benchmark focused on physics reasoning from visual inputs (videos/frames) that evaluates a model's ability to predict physical outcomes, properties, or explanations from short video clips. Tasks typically require understanding dynamics, interactions, and causal relationships in physical scenes and are framed as multiple-choice or VQA-style questions. The dataset is intended to stress visual commonsense and physics-oriented reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face benchmark with limited but growing usage among visual reasoning researchers.
